title: Le Curseur du Désordre
summary: A native range slider from ORDRE to HASARD scales a per-visit random field over a deterministic grid — the chance/order axis made into a dial you drag by hand.
mechanism: An <input type=range> continuously scales a once-seeded RNG offset field (×0 to ×1) over a rule-generated canvas grid of nested squares, redrawing live; the slider track is the chance↔order axis itself.
